title: Remote liveness

scenes.say: A liveness check confirms that a real, live person was in front of the camera, not a printed photo, a screen replay or a deepfake. In this video, you'll send a liveness link and follow the result.

A still selfie can't prove presence. That's why a KYC check from New Verification or a capture link ends in Needs Review, even when everything else passes. Send a liveness link when that's the only thing missing, or before a high-risk action, such as changing the phone number on an M-Pesa account.

show.subtitle: A still selfie can't prove the person was present

scenes.say: Click Liveness in the menu. The Liveness page opens, with the form to send a liveness verification link.
Type the end user's mobile number in international format. Spaces and dashes are fine.
Under Send via, choose SMS or WhatsApp. Liveness links don't go by email.

Then click Send verification link. The customer gets a message with the link, in English. They open it on their phone and do a short camera check. A liveness check costs one credit on Kenya shilling plans, charged when the message is accepted for delivery.

Sent requests shows your 50 most recent requests, newest first, with the contact, the method, the status and when it was sent. The list updates by itself. If a request failed, hold the pointer over the badge to see why.
When the customer finishes, the request shows completed, and Sentinel records a liveness check with its own verdict. Click Overview, and find the row with type Liveness under Recent verifications.
If the verdict is needs review, decide it in Reviews. Choose the Liveness queue to find it. A rejected result means the customer didn't pass, so follow your fraud procedure.

A liveness check stays separate from the KYC check. Sentinel doesn't attach it to the KYC report. So when you decide a KYC case that was held for liveness, note the liveness check's reference in your decision.

show.subtitle: Note its reference when you decide the KYC case

scenes.say: That's remote liveness. To learn more, open chapter B4 in Help, Remote liveness.

notes: Demo Bank Ltd has no seeded liveness requests or liveness checks, so Sent requests may say 'No liveness requests sent yet' and Recent verifications has no Liveness row; the narration describes them generally.
button:SMS highlights the SMS toggle; on this page no other button contains 'SMS'.
Clicking WhatsApp only changes local form state; Send verification link is highlighted, never clicked.
No KYC record in the demo is held only because liveness wasn't collected, so the 'why' scene is a title card.
